comment: Region 1 is one valley with two internal traditions (lowland humors, highland houses), per the release model in DESIGN.md. 'transmission' is how readily a told story takes hold. 'neighbors' is who receives refugees when this region bleeds out.
comment_initial: Starting raw attention per myth per region. A myth not listed is unknown there and can only arrive by being carried in. The shallow-rooted myths start faint on purpose: they are what the player has to rescue.
